name: tree-sitter-compmd
description: CompMD's grammar for tree-sitter: grammars extending tree-sitter-markdown's, with queries for highlighting, folds, injections and text objects.

scripts.generate: pnpm --dir compmd exec tree-sitter generate && pnpm --dir compmd-inline exec tree-sitter generate && pnpm --dir cel exec tree-sitter generate && node scripts/injections.js
scripts.build:wasm: pnpm --dir compmd exec tree-sitter build --wasm && pnpm --dir compmd-inline exec tree-sitter build --wasm && pnpm --dir cel exec tree-sitter build --wasm
scripts.test: pnpm --dir compmd exec tree-sitter test && pnpm --dir compmd-inline exec tree-sitter test && pnpm --dir cel exec tree-sitter test && node --test bindings/node/binding_test.js
